fine_lines.title: can / could / would you be able to
words: I was wondering if you could
fine_lines.explanation_ar: كلها طلبات، لكن درجة الأدب تختلف: Can you أبسطها، Could you أكثر أدباً، Would you be able to و I was wondering if you could أكثر أدباً وتُستخدم لطلب كبير.
fine_lines.explanation_en: All are requests, but the politeness grows: Can you is simple; Could you is more polite; Would you be able to and I was wondering if you could are very polite, good for big requests.

examples.sentence: Would you be able to come downtown?

examples.word: I was wondering if you could
examples.sentence: I was wondering if you could give me some money.

fine_lines.title: I can't vs I wish I could
fine_lines.explanation_ar: I can't رفض مباشر. I wish I could رفض لطيف معناه «أتمنى أن أستطيع لكنني لا أستطيع».
fine_lines.explanation_en: I can't is a direct no. I wish I could is a kind no: "I want to, but I can't."

examples.sentence: Anna, I can't. I'm too busy.
Anna, I wish I could. I'm at the airport.

grammar.title: Polite requests: can, could, would you be able to
grammar.explanation_ar: لطلب شيء من شخص نستخدم: Can you + فعل؟ (عادي)، Could you + فعل؟ (أكثر أدباً)، Would you be able to + فعل؟ (مؤدب جداً). وطريقة أخرى ناعمة: I was wondering if you could + فعل. بعد هذه التعبيرات يأتي الفعل في المصدر (give, come).
grammar.explanation_en: To ask someone to do something: Can you + verb? (normal), Could you + verb? (more polite), Would you be able to + verb? (very polite). Another soft way: I was wondering if you could + verb. Use the base verb after them (give, come).
examples: Would you be able to come downtown?
I was wondering if you could give me some money.

grammar.title: Saying no politely
grammar.explanation_ar: عند الرفض نعتذر ونذكر السبب: I can't. I'm too busy. أو I wish I could, but ... ونستخدم too + صفة لنقول إن الشيء أكثر من اللازم (too busy).
grammar.explanation_en: To say no, say sorry and give a reason: I can't. I'm too busy. Or: I wish I could, but... Use too + adjective to say something is more than it should be (too busy).
examples: Anna, I can't. I'm too busy.
I wish I could. I'm at the airport.
